jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 1715018

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Engagement Manager: M&A Operational diligence and value creation

Strategy and Execution, EY-Parthenon

As you write your next chapter, what shape will it take?

Are you ready to take the next step in your M&A career and work on some of the most exciting deals in the market? We are looking for an Engagement Manager to join the Strategy and Execution team at EY-Parthenon in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will be part of a high-performing team that supports clients across the full deal lifecycle: from M&A strategy to execution. You will work closely with clients on complex, high-impact engagements, where your insights and capabilities will drive real results. At the same time, you will play an active role in shaping our team, contributing to a strong culture and supporting the development of future leaders.

Shape your future with confidence.

Skills and attributes for success

We are looking for a highly motivated and skilled Engagement Manager to join our Strategy and Execution team. The ideal candidate has 7-8+ years of experience in M&A strategy and execution across both pre- and post-deal engagements. You bring experience from client-facing or in-house roles across the M&A cycle and operational delivery, covering:

• Carve-out and operational due diligence

• Assessing standalone viability, cost structures and operational risks to inform deal decisions and separation planning

• Value creation and synergy assessment

• Identifying, quantifying and tracking revenue and cost synergies, and embedding them into value creation plans and integration and execution activities

• Deal strategy and deal management

• Leading deal strategy and execution by being the key contact for client stakeholders and driving governance, planning and milestone tracking across the transaction lifecycle

As an Engagement Manager in the team, you will lead complex M&A engagements, as well as developing our team, so that they can realize their potential.

Your main responsibilities:

• 
Lead and contribute to a variety of pre- and post-deal engagements, including due diligence, deal strategy, synergies and operational value creation and managing workstreams as part of integrations or carve-outs

• 
Assist in aspects of business origination, including pitches and presentations, and working in project teams comprising other colleagues

• 
Contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work

• 
Act as a role model and support development of junior team members, coupled with the recruitment and training responsibilities

What we look for

You value collaboration and bring an inclusive approach, building strong relationships with both clients and colleagues. You are a strong communicator who can translate complex ideas into clear and actionable insights, and you take ownership of your work with a consistent focus on quality and impact.

What’s in it for you

• 
Accelerate your leadership journey by joining as a senior leader within the team, leveraging your transformative leadership skills externally and internally

• 
Broaden your horizons by working on highly integrated teams across the globe and collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds — both professionally and culturally

• 
Embrace flexibility with EY's hybrid work model, empowering you to find the right balance of in-office and client site collaboration with the convenience of remote work

What you can expect during the recruitment process

• Interview process will include two case interviews as well as an interview on personal fit to the team

• Your CV gives us the basics; a strong cover letter helps us understand your motivation and relevant experience beyond M&A consulting

Please submit your application no later than 1 December 2026. Selection and interviews are ongoing. If you have any questions or need more information about the role, please contact Katrin Klit Kronborg, at Katrin.K.Kronborg@parthenon.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, contact Jakob Damsted at Jakob.Damsted@dk.ey.com

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Du laver italiensk mad fra bunden sammen med resten af køkkenet: forretter, pasta og hovedretter. Du er med til forberedelsen om formiddagen og kører din station under service.

You will cook Italian food from scratch together with the rest of the kitchen team: starters, pasta and main courses. You take part in the morning prep and run your own station during service.

We expect

Experience from a professional kitchen. That you can keep the pace and the overview on a busy night. That you work clean and organised. Danish or English on a daily basis.

Full-time position. A stable, experienced team and a restaurant that is busy all year. Salary according to qualifications and the applicable collective agreement. Working hours fall Monday to Sunday between 06:00 and 04:00, typically shifts 11-16 or 16-23.

How to apply

Send your application and CV to mail@soleditalia.dk. We interview on an ongoing basis and invite candidates for a trial shift of about three hours so we can meet in practice.

We are looking for a dedicated and reliable warehouse operative for our client, Bring, in Greve. The position primarily involves picking and packing outdoor equipment during daytime hours.

Your primary responsibilities will include picking and packing smaller outdoor products. You will pick the goods using an electric pallet truck and subsequently pack and prepare the orders for shipment. Most items are picked from floor level or from the second level, where a step ladder is available. In addition, you will carry out general warehouse and terminal duties.

We are looking for someone with a strong work ethic and the right attitude. You are reliable, responsible and willing to get stuck in, while also being able to work independently and proactively and contribute positively to a team. A forklift certificate is an advantage but not a requirement. Much of the work takes place at floor level or from the second level, so not having a forklift certificate should not be a barrier.

Previous warehouse or terminal experience is an advantage, but the most important thing is that you have the right attitude and are motivated to become part of the team.

The job does not involve heavy lifting on a regular basis. Most of the items are relatively small, but you should be comfortable with occasionally having to lift a box down when necessary. It is therefore an advantage if you are comfortable with physically active work and have a good level of physical fitness.

You will be employed on a full-time temporary basis, working Monday to Thursday from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM and Friday from 8:00 AM to 3:30 PM. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible and work until 13 October 2026. Your salary will be in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will obtain one reference from a previous employer during the recruitment process. So don't wait – upload your application and CV today.

Imagine what you could do here. The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. As an Apple Channel Store Advisor, you will showcase your ambitious spirit as you take a lead role in supporting the sales, merchandising, and operations of an Apple Shop within a partner reseller store. As a dynamic leader, business manager, and influencer, you will encourage our partner’s staff through your forward-thinking style, love for technology, and passion for Apple. Through your influence, you will grow Apple business in the multi-branded store by providing excellent customer service, conducting product demonstrations to customers, and training partner staff while ensuring all our merchandising standards are met. In this position, your work schedule will be based on business needs and will require you to work 37.5 hours per week, including evenings and Saturdays. This is a fixed-term position (approximately 14 moths).

Description

In this role, you will: - Represent Apple within a single partner store and help customers develop relationships with our brand. - Share your in-depth knowledge on Apple products directly to customers, work closely with partners, and create new owners of our products. - Provide an amazing customer experience by showcasing our products, accessories, and services. - Proactively seek opportunities to expand awareness for new and existing customers. - Leverage your curiosity for technology and stay up to date on initiatives impacting the customer journey. - Ensure that all Apple fixtures, product exposures, and merchandising elements in the store are up to date and maintained according to Apple's standards. - Provide daily care and inspection according to guidelines and escalate issues for timely and effective resolution. - Educate customers by delivering individual and group product demonstrations, sharing the latest sales promotions, and encouraging adoption of the Apple platform.

Minimum Qualifications

• Minimum of 2 years of related experience.

• Passion for helping customers and partners understand how Apple technology can enrich lives.

• Curiosity for continuous learning and eagerness to share knowledge with others.

• Outstanding customer focus.

• Excellent communication skills.

• Ability to educate and inspire others.

• Solid relationship building skills with the ability to become a trusted business partner at a single point of sale.

• Fluency in Danish and ability to communicate in English.

Preferred Qualifications

• High level of integrity, trust, and accountability.

• Strong self motivation and ability to work independently in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.

• Effective time management including ability to multitask, organize, and prioritize tasks.

• Ambition for driving sales results and recommending Apple solutions is desirable.

• Background in direct sales or solution-based selling is a plus.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

SAS is expanding! We are pleased to announce that applications are now open for our Fall 2026 Cabin Crew courses.

SAS is expanding - connecting people, cultures, and destinations like never before, and inviting you to be part of it.

We are now looking for more colleagues who want to be a part of this journey.

As part of the SAS Cabin Crew team, you will meet people from all around the world. You will take pride in creating a safe and welcoming experience for Scandinavia’s travelers by ensuring onboard safety, delivering great service and sales on SAS flights. The role involves varying schedules, requiring a high level of flexibility and adaptability in your day-to-day work.

SAS believes that diversity makes the team stronger. By working together, SAS fosters an inclusive workplace where everyone can feel valued and where every journey and every person matter.

Minimum Requirements

• 
Minimum age 18 years.

• 
Height at least 160 cm (without shoes).

• 
Completed education to a minimum level of high school or equivalent level.

• 
Minimum 2 years of work experience in a customer-facing role. Hospitality, sales and service experience is considered an advantage.

• 
Fluent in English language (Berlitz level B2/gym. Min. B).

• 
Strong swimming skills.

• 
Able to comply with uniform regulations: Visible tattoos are allowed below the neck, excluding hands and chest. One small, discreet tattoo, no larger than 1,5cm is, however, acceptable on the hand and right behind the ear (not extending onto back of head or neck). Visible tattoos should not be offensive or religious motives.

• 
Valid EU passport allowing free travel worldwide.

• 
Eligible to live and work permanently in Denmark.

• 
You must be available to work scheduled shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

• 
Able to get to Copenhagen Kastrup Airport (CPH) within 1h and 20 min on standby duties.

Addition requirements for experienced Cabin Crew

• 
Valid EASA Attestation and Medical.

• 
Minimum of one year of continuous experience as Senior Cabin Crew, within the past five years.

Security & Medical Requirements

• 
Employment requires an approved Security Assessment which includes security interview, 5-year-background check, reference check and exhaustive police certificate/clean record.

• 
Approved/passed training course, and that you meet the company’s requirements set for cabin crew.

• 
Good physical and mental health, as well as good vision (+/- 0.7 with or without corrections). Can be health approved according to EASA Regulations. To read more about medical certification for Cabin Crew, click here.

• 
Employment also requires completed and passed drug and alcohol tests (blood and urine samples).

• 
Our premises and work are located within the airport security-related area; therefore you must be approved by the aviation authorities.

• 
All the steps above must be approved before commencing the Cabin Crew training.

**Personal Qualities
**You are someone who:

• 
Has a strong service mindset and connects naturally with people through strong interpersonal and communication skills.

• 
Contributes to a safe, efficient, and welcoming onboard environment on every flight.

• 
Maintain a professional, calm, and solution-oriented attitude in all situations.

• 
Are a strong team player and adaptable, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

• 
Resilient and can manage irregular hours and changing schedules.

**

SAS Culture**

At Scandinavian Airlines, the focus is on caring for people, delivering exceptional experiences for travelers, and advancing the transition toward more sustainable aviation. This is guided by the iCARE framework, reflecting a commitment to Inspiration, Collaboration, Accountability, Recognition, and Execution in everything they do.

As a future team member, candidates can expect to be part of a collaborative environment where shared goals drive performance, contributions are recognized, and successes are celebrated. The organization places strong emphasis on safe, sustainable, and punctual operations, while actively working to reduce environmental impact and transform for the future

SAS is proud to operate through three owned subsidiaries; SAS Scandinavia, SAS Connect and SAS Link. We are excited to offer exciting career opportunities, including permanent positions and employment in 100%, 80% and 0% Resource pool. Although you might have a preference, we always give the option of the available position we have at the time.

If you meet the above qualifications and would like to join SAS Cabin Crew team, we encourage you to submit your application by clicking “Apply Now”.

Recruitment will take place based on operational needs. The first courses are planned for fall and winter 2026/2027. Due to high number of applications, response time may be longer than usual. You are always welcome to contact us at cc@aapaviation.com.

Our Recruitment Journey

• 
Application and online assessment: You will complete a set of application questions along with a video introduction where you have the chance to showcase yourself and to stand out. Once submitted, we will review your skills and experience.

• 
Assessment Center: If your application is successful, the next step will be an invitation to attend our assessment day.

• 
Post Assessment: Before employment can be offered you will need to complete various checks including reference checks, criminal record checks and security clearance.

• 
Pre-employment checks: Successful candidates will need to complete a medical examination and drug- and alcohol test.

• 
Cabin Crew Training: If you have passed all the requirements, you can start our 4-week Cabin Crew training program which will prepare you for a career in the sky.

Job Description Summary

As a Service Sales Specialist for Surgery at GE HealthCare, you will play a key role in expanding our service business across the Nordics and the Netherlands. By building trusted customer relationships and delivering innovative lifecycle solutions, you will help healthcare providers maximize equipment uptime, optimize operational performance, and deliver exceptional patient care.

Working closely with local sales and service teams, you will identify new business opportunities, develop strategic service offerings, and drive sustainable growth within our Surgery and C-arm portfolio. This role combines commercial leadership, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic international environment.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

• 
Sell point-of-sale service contracts and solutions while protecting margin by communicating value and maintaining pricing discipline.

• 
Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of GE HealthCare’s service solutions and relevant competitive offerings.

• 
Develop account penetration strategies for key target and competitive accounts, and communicate market intelligence, field concerns, emerging issues, and customer requirements to the wider business.

• 
Lead customer negotiations and close deals by engaging key buying stakeholders, including technical and biomedical personnel, department heads, and C-suite executives.

• 
Achieve annual and quarterly revenue targets through accurate monthly and quarterly forecasting, effective prioritization of selling time, increased sales volume, deeper account penetration, and comprehensive territory coverage.

• 
Maintain strong after-sales relationships, develop long-term customer partnerships, and identify opportunities that address both immediate and evolving customer needs.

Key Qualifications:

• 
At least one of the following core experiences (+ 3 years)

• 
consultative sales or market experience including strategic selling and negotiation in a complex sales environment involving multiple decisionmakers/ influencers.

• 
Healthcare service experience, preferable in Diagnostic Imaging, Ultrasound or Patient Care Solutions.

• 
Experience in customer facing roles.

• 
Excellent Danish and English language skills.

• 
Willingness to travel within the assigned geographic region

Desired Characteristics:

• 
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, technology, healthcare, or a related field, or equivalent knowledge and experience.

• 
Previous Healthcare sales experience.

• 
Strong interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

• 
Strong written and verbal communication and clear-thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex issues into simple messages.

• 
Solid process orientation, demonstrated resource management and allocation experience, and the ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously.

• 
Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport at all levels within an organization.

• 
Experience interfacing with both internal team members and external customers as a part of a solution-based sales process.

Inclusion and Diversity

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Behaviors

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Total Rewards

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Creativity Apps team needs your help shaping the next generation of creative editing tools by working on state-of-the-art technologies to surprise and delight creative pros and enthusiasts alike. You’ll be working with the world-class teams behind Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, iMovie, and GarageBand to create next-generation tools for creators!

We're looking for a Performance Tooling Engineer to own the tooling and automated tests that keep our products fast, efficient, and correct. Your mission is to catch regressions before they ship, across latency, memory, power/thermals and functionality, by building the test harnesses, benchmarks, and CI infrastructure that make regressions visible, reproducible, and actionable. The systems you build will run continuously across our device fleet and become the safety net our engineering team relies on. If you enjoy turning "it feels slower" into a hard number on a dashboard with a bisected culprit commit, this is for you.

• 
Design, write, and maintain automated tests that detect performance regressions (latency, memory footprint, power consumption, etc.) and functional regressions.

• 
Build and operate CI pipelines and tooling that run these tests reliably across a fleet of hardware devices.

• 
Create dashboards, alerting, and triage tooling that surface regressions early and help engineers root-cause them quickly, e.g. automated bisection, historical trend tracking.

• 
Partner with cross-functional teams & leadership to define meaningful performance goals and acceptance criteria.

• 
Continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, flakiness, and the developer experience of running and interpreting tests.

• 
Very strong problem-solving and coding skills.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Experience building and maintaining CI systems.

• 
Solid understanding of performance measurement fundamentals: how to benchmark reliably, control for noise, and reason about latency, memory, and power/thermal metrics.

• 
Experience writing automated tests and the tooling/frameworks around them.

• 
Proven track record of integrating AI tools to enhance both personal productivity and team workflows.

• 
Experience developing for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS), with working knowledge of Swift.

• 
Familiarity with the Apple development toolchain: Xcode, Instruments, and related profiling and testing.

•

Working closely with Finance, Corporate Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, DD&AI, Business COE, affiliates, and external partners, the SAP Manager will drive SAP best practices and facilitate cross-functional decisions aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards, and Genmab’s SAP S/4HANA roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

SAP SD Solution & Delivery

• Lead SAP SD and logistics design, configuration, implementation, enhancement, and support across S/4HANA implementations, upgrades, and rollouts.

• Provide functional expertise across end-to-end OTC processes, including sales order management, pricing, availability checking, delivery, shipping and transportation, billing, returns, credit/debit processing, and credit management.

• Support customer and business partner master data, intercompany transactions, and third-party sales scenarios.

• Manage process integration between SAP SD, MM, FI/CO, EWM/WM, TM, and external systems.

• Translate business requirements into scalable solutions through fit-to-standard/fit-gap analysis, prioritizing standard S/4HANA capabilities and minimizing unnecessary customization.

• Advise on S/4HANA simplifications and process changes affecting SD and logistics.

• Coordinate functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization.

• Maintain documentation of requirements, functional designs, configurations, test scenarios, and operating procedures.

• Oversee production support, resolve complex issues, and drive root-cause analysis and permanent solutions for recurring problems.

• Ensure solutions comply with Genmab policies, internal controls, and audit expectations; support audits and timely remediation of findings

Business & Stakeholder Management

• Facilitate requirements workshops, identify process improvements, prioritize enhancements, and support solution decisions and adoption.

• Optimize order fulfillment, delivery, and shipping across internal operations and external logistics partners.

• Align billing, credit management, intercompany transactions, and financial integration with accounting processes and control requirements.

• Coordinate architecture and design reviews, interfaces, APIs, enhancements, reports, forms, and workflows, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and the SAP roadmap.

• Communicate SAP concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and manage expectations, priorities, dependencies, risks, and issues across initiatives.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is a plus.

• 8+ years of SAP SD and logistics experience, including 3+ years with SAP S/4HANA.

• Participation in at least one full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation, from requirements through stabilization; experience leading an SD or logistics workstream preferred.

• Strong hands-on expertise in SAP SD, end-to-end Order-to-Cash, and related logistics and supply chain processes.

• Experience integrating SAP SD with MM, FI/CO, EWM/WM, and TM; broader experience with EWM, TM, or GTS preferred.

• Experience with SAP configuration, functional specifications, testing, data migration, cutover, and production support.

• Working knowledge of SAP Fiori and S/4HANA capabilities; relevant SAP certification preferred.

• Experience integrating SAP with 3PLs, warehouse systems, transportation providers, or customer platforms, and familiarity with APIs, IDocs, EDI, and middleware preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business and technology teams; experience managing implementation partners and managed service providers preferred.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a complex enterprise environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills, with a focus on sustainable solutions and continuous improvement.

• Life sciences experience and knowledge of commercialization and supply chain processes preferred, along with experience supporting global SAP deployments.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
